name: tlrc
description: Official tldr client from the tldr-pages project, written in Rust

avoid.scoop: scoop's manifest sets TLRC_CONFIG in your user environment to its persist folder and deletes %APPDATA%\tlrc, which competes with the TLRC_CONFIG DotForge sets.

xdg.instructions: TLRC_CONFIG is the config file itself, not its folder (tlrc 1.13.1). The page cache stays in tlrc's OS folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\tlrc); the config's cache.dir expands only ~, not variables.
